note: Campbell County says it has no countywide zoning commission; zoning is set by each municipality (LaFollette, Jellico, Caryville, Jacksboro). LaFollette's zoning map is a JPG image; city zoning ordinances are PDF codes with no zoning map as a queryable service. No public ArcGIS REST zoning district layer found for the county or its cities after searching ArcGIS Hub/Online, state portal, and city/county sites. Only commercial parcel data (Regrid, dynamospatial) carries zoning attributes, under license terms, so not used.
